verdict.rationale: CDP docs describe programmatic provisioning of per-customer deposit addresses that auto-credit a custodial account (docs-1, docs-22), and the cdp-sdk client libraries let developers manage EVM/Solana wallets while CDP secures private keys, with an explicit custodial vs non-custodial distinction (gh-1, docs-7). This covers per-customer address provisioning and basic custody semantics via API/SDK.  Missing for 10: a full API reference (openapi probe returned 404) detailing wallet-creation endpoints/parameters, and independent third-party verification of key custody guarantees.
